map.为什么中文分词结果和分词软件不一样？: Why do Chinese segmentation results differ from segmentation software?
map.本工具用的是轻量切分：把连续汉字串切开后按最小词长取窗口，没有词典与词性模型，所: This tool uses lightweight segmentation: it splits consecutive Chinese strings and windows by minimum length, with no dictionary or POS model, so a string containing overlapping sub-strings may yield both the whole and its short windows. For rigorous frequency research, verify with a professional segmenter or raise the minimum length to filter fragments.
map.TTR 随文本长度自然下降：几百词的短文常在 60%~80%，上万词的长文降到: TTR naturally falls with text length: a few-hundred-word passage often sits at 60%~80%, while a ten-thousand-word text dropping below 30% is normal. Its purpose is to compare whether two similarly long passages use richer vocabulary; cross-length comparison is meaningless—trim to equal-length excerpts if needed.
map.开启后 the / a / of / is 之类高频虚词会被剔除，总词次与唯一词: After enabling, high-frequency function words like the / a / of / is are removed; both total and unique counts drop, leaving words closer to topic words; but the share denominator also shrinks, so compare two texts under the same on/off state.
map.词汇丰富度 TTR = 唯一词数 ÷ 总词次，文本越长该值天然越低，比较不同长度: Lexical richness TTR = unique words ÷ total words; the longer the text, the lower this value naturally, so don't rely on TTR alone when comparing different lengths.
map.英文停用词过滤基于内置词表（the / a / of / is 等）；开启后总词: English stop-word filtering uses a built-in list (the / a / of / is, etc.); enabling it lowers both total and unique counts, changing the share basis.
map.中文按连续汉字串切分后再按最小词长做滑窗，未引入词典分词，属轻量切分；严格的分词: Chinese is split by consecutive character strings then windowed by minimum length, with no dictionary segmentation—a lightweight method; verify strict results with a professional segmenter.
map.最小词长按字符数计（英文按字母数）。设为 2 可滤掉 is / a 之类的短词，: Minimum length is counted in characters (letters for English). Set to 2 to filter short words like is / a; set ≥4 for better topic-word extraction.
map.全部统计在浏览器内完成，粘贴长文或内部资料都不会上传到服务器。: All statistics run in the browser; pasting long texts or internal documents never uploads to the server.
